lessons.finding: projectCheck lost observed suite results when an ancillary native grammar did not return; CLI child processes could also select a different Node runtime through PATH.
lessons.conclusion: Reproduced an unbounded post-suite security parse. Exact installed-source baseline and repaired self-check both pass their designated suite. Synthetic interruption and non-cooperative process tests verify immutable progress checkpoints and bounded failure without false passing evidence. The repaired checker completed a full external application run and retained its passing tests plus existing code-quality failures. Intermediate dogfood complexity regressions were corrected; outcome CRAP 9 to 6, saveRun 1 to 4, withSyntax 3 to 4. No application speed or cost improvement is inferred.
lessons.nextRule: Keep suite outcomes durable before ancillary analysis, isolate non-cooperative native grammars, report timed-out scopes as unassessed, and preserve the selected Node runtime across subprocesses. Use completed comparable run timestamps for learning records; interruption is not a successful baseline.
